summary: A versioned, machine-readable statement of which Aegis documents and rules govern a source-library (Role A) or consumer (Role B) work item, how the governance dependency is resolved for five entry-route families, what a context receipt must record, and what this repository can and cannot enforce on the observed host. It binds authoritative documents and rules by identity and declares applicability, lifecycle and local adoption; it neither replaces any authoritative document nor creates approval, and it does not enforce at runtime.

authoritative_inputs: the target git tree bytes at a revision
the contract bytes in the payload
the register bytes for the source role
the consumer's adoption record and local policy hashes
trust.verification_rule: every claim is re-derived in-turn against an authoritative input; a self-asserted receipt is evidence, never authority
